info.title: Lint SQL files for Aurora DSQL compatibility
info.description: Lint SQL files for Aurora DSQL compatibility

options.name: --fix
options.description: Fix mode: output DSQL-compatible SQL to a new file. Note: SQL comments in modified statements will not be preserved

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (only with --fix and a single input file)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format [default: text] [possible values: text, json]

options.name: --version
options.description:
Print version
EXIT CODES:
0  Clean (no issues) or all issues fixed without warnings
1  Errors found (lint mode) or unfixable errors remain (fix mode)
2  Usage error (invalid arguments)
3  Fix mode only: all issues fixed, but some produced warnings
CI USAGE:
Exit code 3 means the fix succeeded but produced warnings (e.g., removed
foreign keys). In shell scripts with set -e or CI pipelines, handle it:
dsql-lint --fix input.sql; rc=$?
if [ $rc -eq 1 ]; then echo 'unfixable errors'; exit 1; fi
# rc 0 or 3: fix succeeded (3 = review warnings)
